simple.summary: כִּרְסֵם (kirçêm) means to lay waste First listed occurrence: Ps 80 14.

definitions.full: H3765. kirsem [ כִּרְסֵם ] verb quadriliteral = Pi`el , tear off (compare קִרְסֵם Late Hebrew cut or eat away , Deut 28:38 ᵑ7 J for חָסַל ; on form see Ges § 56 ); — only Imperfect 3masculine singular suffix: — מִיָּ֫עַר חֲזִיר יְכַרְסְמֶנָּה Psa 80:14 teareth it off (that is, the vine, figurative of Israel).
